title: Noise-adjusted turnover in estimated networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.20044v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Economic networks are often estimated separately over two periods, and changes in their edge sets are interpreted as structural rewiring. Since both networks are estimated, observed turnover also reflects graph-selection error. We study the two-snapshot Hamming-turnover functional under a homogeneous edge-misclassification model. With known sensitivity and specificity and conditional independence of the estimated edge indicators across periods, latent turnover admits a closed-form unbiased adjustment based only on observed turnover and the two estimated graph sizes. We then examine the effects of sparsity, calibration error and dependence across periods. When the number of true links is proportional to $p$, a false-positive probability of order $p^{-1}$ generates expected spurious turnover of order $p$. translated_title: 估计网络中的噪声校正更迭
translated_abstract: 经济网络通常在两个时期分别进行估计，其边集的变化被解释为结构性重构。由于两个网络都是估计得到的，观察到的更迭也反映了图选择误差。我们在均质边误分类模型下研究两快照汉明更迭泛函。在已知敏感性和特异性以及跨时期估计边指标条件独立的情况下，潜在更迭可以仅基于观察到的更迭和两个估计图的大小得到闭式无偏调整。随后我们考察了稀疏性、校准误差以及跨时期依赖性的影响。当真实链接数量与 $p$ 成比例时，数量级为 $p^{-1}$ 的假阳性概率会产生数量级为 $p$ 的期望虚假更迭。校准假阳性概率时同数量级的误差同样会在调整后留下数量级为 $p$ 的偏差。
tldr: 本文针对两时期估计的经济网络，提出仅依赖观测更迭和估计图规模的闭式无偏调整方法以校正由边误分类引起的虚假网络更迭，并揭示了稀疏性与校准误差可能导致的数量级为 p 的残余偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a closed-form unbiased adjustment for spurious turnover in two-period estimated economic networks, using only observed turnover and estimated graph sizes under edge misclassification, and shows how sparsity and calibration errors can leave order-p bias after adjustment.
